listing.name: Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition — mcdub3-nx (laureladastra)
listing.summary: Version0.3.0 is experimental: crashes, latency and occasional race hangs remain. Upstream claims Mac/Linux30FPS with5x upscale; M1/macOS15.6 and Ubuntu22.04.5 VM are the named tests. Windows11 VM/Intel i7 support is still experimental. Switch100% career progress is a separate destination observation and is not desktop completion evidence. No Portcove runtime/gameplay qualification. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own original Xbox Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition NTSC-U or PAL Europe disc. Supply extracted default.xbe plus all disc files; make extract ISO=<own.iso> prepares Unix routes and the Windows installer can extract the owned ISO. Regional discs use separate game/ and game-eur/ folders. Exact XBE revision/hash is Unknown. Do not treat the separate Remix PAL development/NRO claim as an accepted desktop source profile.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Source preparation owned by upstream/player. macOS: install Xcode command-line tools/Homebrew, make setup, extract own DUB Edition disc, make lift, then make mac-app DISC=<disc-folder> or make build run. Linux: make setup, own-disc extraction, make lift and make build run; CPU matrix remains Unknown. Windows: install_windows.bat installs MSYS2 in C:\msys64 if absent, obtains dependencies, lifts code and builds the personal runtime; this is local compilation, not a precompiled player download. No commands were executed by Portcove. Desktop Remix preparation is not established.
